claim_scope: Every ID / IDF is exact only conditional on the true machine having at most the declared N states (Exact) and, for certify/20n, on iid bit noise with eps <= eps_bar (the majority trace is wrong somewhere with probability at most delta = 0.001; Inferred union bound). Random emissions only; repeat reads of an unchanged state; one transition-graph family; 12 seeds.

The negative control (eps 0.25 against eps_bar 0.10) also had 0 majority errors, so it is weak. 2-bit readings at 20 states stay Open.
